title: Preparation of a novel high-entropy alloy AlNbTiVZr with excellent strength and ductility: The effect of Zr composition on microstructure and properties
process_description: prepared by vacuum arc melting in a water-cooled copper crucible, repeated eight times with magnetic agitation for homogenization
